scope: Fresh generated Tour with coordinated probes and one regenerated tangent-lead weld; finite sampling, modeled clocks; no whole-tour physical or manufacturing acceptance.

timed_pose_bead.timed_pose_position_scale: stage chord length in metres; objective normalization only
timed_pose_bead.trace_scope: Successful QP trials only; failed QPs do not invoke the native callback. Dynamic row counts reflect the last constraint evaluation.

probe_stop_assumption: Zero TCP velocity at exact process corners, with modeled arm/track nullspace motion. SearchL hit is hypothetical at the commanded limit.
join_check_scope: Existing mixed-axis SQP feasibility band applied to modeled q/qd/qdd join residuals; not a physical tolerance or observed boundary derivative.
